normalization: None: primary results use raw production validator
selection: No iterative edits after results. Compare all arms and policy repeat. Report validity, control regressions, challenge recovery, abstentions and extra tag additions separately; no single aggregate winner score.
policyStatus: Taxonomy conventions are experimental hypotheses, not confirmed user preferences. Broad household/personal additions disabled, so suppression is policy enforcement rather than inferred precision.
limitations: All source documents exposed previously. Same source repeated across conditions and arms. Existing labels are nonexhaustive tag targets. Dates/types can have legitimate focus disagreements. No deployment acceptance claim.
